query: Operators were drowning in subsystem logs, so I designed a new dashboard in Java with C backend services on Oracle, and also optimised the insert-heavy ingestion with batching and retries. About 30% of log traffic now goes to the new dashboard. Make resume bullets from this.
expected_behavior: Identifies two separate pieces of work (the dashboard and the ingestion optimisation)
Shows the proposed split and asks the user to confirm before drafting or saving
Attributes the 30% traffic redirection to the dashboard only
Asks for the missing result of the ingestion optimisation
